chrome.signOutBody: You'll need to sign in again. Unsaved work in this session will be lost.

settings.title: Settings
settings.languageDescription: The dashboard and API follow this culture. Product names fall back to English when a translation is missing.
settings.themeDescription: Pick a colour mode for the dashboard. System follows your OS.
settings.loadProfileFailed: Couldn't load your profile. Showing details from your session; saved changes may not reflect the latest server state.
settings.photoDesc: Shown in the topbar and on your activity. Square crops work best — JPG, PNG, or WebP.
settings.identityDesc: Your name and contact details, visible across the dashboard.
settings.emailHint: Contact your tenant admin to change your sign-in email.
settings.subjectIdDesc: The unique ID this account uses inside the platform. Read-only.
settings.activeSessionsDesc: Browsers and devices currently signed in to your account.
settings.noSessionsBody: Session activity will appear here once you sign in from any device.
settings.passwordDesc: Used to sign in to this tenant. Choose a strong, unique password.
settings.passwordHint: We recommend a passphrase of 16+ characters with no reuse from other services.
settings.changePasswordDesc: Pick a strong password you don't reuse elsewhere. Your other signed-in sessions stay active — revoke them below if you want them out.
settings.passwordChangedBody: Other active sessions remain valid until you revoke them.
settings.useAtLeast8: New password must be at least 8 characters.
settings.mustDiffer: New password must differ from the current one.
settings.twoFaDesc: Require a one-time code from an authenticator app on every sign-in.
settings.enrollHint: You'll scan a QR code in your authenticator app (1Password, Google Authenticator, Authy, …).
settings.twoFaEnabledBody: Future logins require a 6-digit code from your authenticator.
settings.codeMismatch: That code didn't match. Try again.
settings.twoFaDisableDesc: Two-factor is currently enabled. Confirm your password to disable — this rotates the authenticator secret, so a fresh enroll will generate a new QR code.
settings.notifDesc: Choose which events you want delivered as email or in-app notifications.
settings.notifPlaceholderBody: In-app notifications are already delivered to your bell — open it from the top bar to see them. Granular per-event email opt-ins are on the v1.1 roadmap. In the meantime, your tenant admin can disable email delivery globally.
settings.apiKeysDesc: Long-lived credentials used by services to call the FSH API. Treat them like passwords.
settings.apiKeysPlaceholderBody: Personal access tokens and service-to-service API keys are on the v1.1 roadmap. For now, your access flows through the user-bound JWT issued at sign-in. Track progress on the public roadmap or watch the next release notes.
settings.pasteHint: Direct link to an image you host elsewhere.
settings.noPublicUrl: Server returned no publicUrl for this file.

auth.inactivity: You were signed out due to inactivity.
auth.demoSignIn: Sign in with a demo account
auth.resetSubtitle: Enter the email you sign in with. We'll send a one-time link.
auth.inboxBodyAfter: , a one-time reset link is on its way. The link expires in 30 minutes.
auth.inboxTipSpam: Didn't get it? Wait a minute, then check spam.
auth.inboxTipRetry: Still nothing? Confirm the email + tenant and try again.
auth.passwordUpdatedBody: Sign in with your new password to continue.
auth.linkIncompleteBody: The reset link is missing one of token, email, or tenant. Some email clients clip long URLs — try copy-pasting the full link from the original email into your browser's address bar.
auth.verifyingBody: One moment — checking the confirmation token with the server.
auth.emailConfirmedDefault: Your email is confirmed. You can now sign in.
auth.confirmExpiredHint: The link may have expired or been used already. If you've signed in since this email was sent, you can ignore it.
auth.confirmMalformed: This confirmation link is missing required parameters. It may have been clipped by your email client.
auth.demoDescription: Pick a demo tenant and account to sign in with.
auth.demoHint: Explore fullstackhero as any user across the demo tenants — we'll sign you in instantly.
auth.inactivityBody: You've been inactive for a while. We'll sign you out shortly to keep your account secure.

shop.noStoresBody: Ask an operator to create a customer and store before ordering.
shop.needStore: Select a store to see contract prices and place orders.
shop.catalogDescription: Prices are quoted for the selected store. Catalog list prices are never shown here.
shop.cartDescription: Quoted prices follow the selected store's contract.
shop.ordersDescription: Reserved orders can be amended or cancelled before cutoff.
shop.emptyCartBody: Add products from the catalog to place an order.
shop.noProductsBody: The catalog is empty for this tenant.
shop.noOrdersBody: Place an order from the cart to see it here.
shop.amendNeedsLines: Keep at least one line, or cancel the order.
shop.confirmCancel: Cancel this order? Reserved stock will be released.
shop.beforeCutoff: You can amend or cancel until cutoff.
shop.afterCutoff: This order is locked. Changes are no longer allowed.
shop.noClaimsBody: Received orders can be claimed here after delivery.

ops.scanGuid: Scan an order id or tote id (GUID).
ops.shipmentsDescription: Build a route shipment, scan an order or tote onto the truck, depart, then capture POD with photos.
ops.noShipmentsBody: Create a shipment for packed orders on a route, then load it here.
ops.putawayDescription: Confirm inbound or return lots onto a same-zone storage or pick location.
ops.noPutawayBody: QC pass and on-truck returns create pending putaway tasks.
ops.purchaseDescription: Register a supplier, raise a draft PO, then send it so QC can receive.
ops.noPosYetBody: Create a supplier and a draft PO, then send it for QC.
ops.wavesDescription: Cutoff auto-builds draft waves by zone and route. Release FEFO, then pack.
ops.noWavesBody: Run cutoff to lock orders and draft waves, then release FEFO.
ops.qcDescription: Pass or fail inbound lines. Purchasing and QC are separate permissions.
ops.noPosBody: Inbound POs that are sent or receiving show up here for QC.
ops.picksDescription: Scan the allocated lot. A wrong lot is rejected.
ops.noPicksBody: Release a wave to allocate FEFO lots onto pick tasks.

users.title: Users
users.description: Every member with access to this tenant. Register newcomers, review status, and manage roles.
users.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, username, or email…
users.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{q}". Try a different term or clear the filters.
users.emptyFilterBody: No users match the current filters.
users.emptyBody: Register the first member to seed this tenant. They'll receive a confirmation email if email confirmation is enabled.
users.registeredBody: An email confirmation may be required before sign-in.
users.registerDesc: Add a new user to this tenant. Username and email must be unique. Passwords need an uppercase letter, lowercase letter, and a digit.
users.usernameHint: Used at sign-in. Lowercase, no spaces.
users.impersonationStartedBody: You're now acting as this user. Use the banner to end.
users.identityCardDesc: Read-only here. Members update their own profile from settings.
users.roleAssignmentDesc: Toggle which roles apply. Changes are staged until saved.
users.deleteBody: This permanently removes {name}. They will lose access immediately. This cannot be undone.
users.deactivateBody: {name} will not be able to sign in until reactivated. Existing sessions remain unless revoked.
users.impersonateBody: You'll act as this user across the dashboard. Every action you take will be attributed to them in audit logs (with your operator id preserved as the actor). End impersonation from the banner at the top of the page when you're done.
users.reasonLabel: Reason (optional, recorded in the audit log)
users.reasonPlaceholder: Investigating a bug report from this user…
users.revokeAllBody: Every active session — desktop, mobile, browser tab — will be ended immediately. The user will need to sign in again on each device.
users.noSessions: No sessions on file. The user hasn't signed in recently.

roles.title: Roles
roles.description: Roles bundle permissions into named bands of authority. Assign them from the user detail page.
roles.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{q}". Try a different term or clear the search.
roles.emptyBody: Create the first role to start grouping permissions. Without roles, members default to no access.
roles.createDesc: Roles bundle permissions. After creating, you'll be taken to the editor to assign permissions and tune access.
roles.name: Name
roles.descriptionHint: Shown to admins when assigning roles. Plain English helps.
roles.systemSubtitle: Built-in role managed by the framework.
roles.systemBannerBody: ships with the framework. Its name, description, and permissions are managed centrally so the seed contract and the runtime permission syncer stay in agreement. Create a custom role if you need a different set of grants.
roles.detailsDesc: The display label and a one-line summary admins will see at assignment time.
roles.permsDesc: Search, filter, and toggle individual permissions — or seed a sensible default from a preset. Some root-level permissions may be filtered server-side.
roles.searchPerms: Search by resource, action, or description…
roles.noPermsMatchBody: Try a different term or clear the current filter.
roles.deleteBody: This permanently removes {name}. Members currently assigned will lose its permissions immediately.
roles.rootTitle: Root-level permission. May be filtered server-side.

groups.title: Groups
groups.description: Groups bundle members and roles into reusable cohorts. Add a user to a group to grant every role attached to that group.
groups.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{q}". Try a different term.
groups.emptyFilterBody: No groups match the current filters.
groups.emptyBody: Create the first group to bundle members and roles. Useful for teams, departments, or feature cohorts.
groups.createDesc: Groups bundle members and roles. After creating, you'll be taken to the editor to attach roles and add members.
groups.name: Name
groups.descriptionHint: Helps admins understand what this cohort represents.
groups.detailsDesc: Name, description, and the roles attached to this group.
groups.descPlaceholder: Short summary of who or what this group represents
groups.membersDesc: Users who belong to this group inherit every role attached above.
groups.noMembers: No one in this group yet. Click Add members to attach users.
groups.deleteBody: {name} will be removed. Members will lose any permissions inherited through this group.
groups.pickDesc: Search active users and select one or more to attach to this group.
groups.searchUsers: Search by name, username, or email…

catalog.name: Name
catalog.slugHint: Auto-derived from the name. Used in URLs.
catalog.descListingHint: Shown on listing and product detail pages.

brands.title: Brands
brands.pageDesc: Curate the maker imprints behind every product. Each brand carries its own slug, story, and logo.
brands.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{q}". Try a different term or clear the search.
brands.emptyFilterBody: No brands match the current filters.
brands.emptyBody: Add your first brand to start building the catalog. Each brand carries its own slug, description, and logo.
brands.editDesc: Update details for {name}. The slug is re-derived from the name.
brands.addDesc: Add a brand to your catalog. The slug is generated automatically from the name.
brands.logoHint: Optional. Public URL to the brand's logo image.
brands.deleteBody: This permanently removes {name} ({created}). Products referencing this brand will need to be reassigned.

categories.title: Categories
categories.pageDesc: Group products into shelves. Categories nest under parents to form the taxonomy customers browse.
categories.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{q}". Try a different term or clear the search.
categories.emptyFilterBody: No categories match the current filters.
categories.emptyBody: Categories give your catalog its tree. Create root shelves, then nest sub-shelves under them.
categories.editDesc: Update details for {name}. The slug is re-derived from the name.
categories.addDesc: Add a category to your catalog. The slug is generated automatically from the name.
categories.parentHint: Optional. Leave empty to make this a root category.
categories.deleteBody: This permanently removes {name} ({created}). Categories with child categories cannot be deleted — move or delete the children first.

products.title: Products
products.pageDesc: Browse and manage the catalog. Each product carries a SKU, brand, category, and list price. Available quantity is Inventory ATP.
products.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, SKU, or slug…
products.emptySearchBody: Nothing matches "{q}". Try a different term or clear the filters.
products.emptyFilterBody: No products match the current filters.
products.emptyBody: Add your first product to start selling. Each carries its own SKU, price, and image. Stock is received in Inventory.
products.atpManaged: Available quantity is managed by Inventory
products.editDesc: Update details for {name}. Use the inline price chip on the row to change list price.
products.addDesc: Add a product to your catalog. List price can be adjusted inline after creation. Stock is received in Inventory.
products.skuHint: Stock-keeping unit. Becomes the canonical identifier.
products.priceEvent: Emits a ProductPriceChanged domain event for {name}.
products.deleteBody: This permanently removes {name} ({created}). The product will no longer appear in any listing or report.
products.descriptionHint: Customer-facing copy shown on the product page.
products.imagesHint: Drop more to add. Star one to make it the cover.
products.stockRetired: Catalog product stock is retired. Receive, reserve, and isolate live in Inventory.
products.notFoundBody: It may have been deleted, or the link may be wrong.
products.editDescDetail: Update details for {name}. Use the price action in the sidebar to change list price. Available quantity lives in Inventory.

products.imageFormats: JPG / PNG / WebP / GIF · up to 10 MB
